corrections.issue: The training unit says snapshots persist until deleted, but the current cited product documentation limits supported retention to 10 years; the unqualified expansion implied indefinite retention.
corrections.correction: Added the current supported retention limit of up to 10 years and kept deliberate obsolete-snapshot deletion guidance.

corrections.before: Automatic backups exclude linked databases. Custom backups support only specified linked database types, and linked-database backup support is scheduled to end on 31 March 2028. A database used by an application is not automatically protected merely because the web app has backups. Plan database recovery through a supported database backup mechanism where needed. Custom backups can use firewall-protected storage when the documented virtual-network configuration permits it; the old blanket claim that any storage firewall makes backups impossible is too broad.
corrections.after: Automatic backups exclude linked databases. Existing custom backups that already include linked databases continue to protect them until 31 March 2028. New custom backup configurations stopped offering linked MySQL and PostgreSQL databases in November 2025, and linked Azure SQL and SQL Server databases in April 2026. Plan database recovery through the database service’s supported backup mechanism. Custom backups can use firewall-protected storage when the documented virtual-network configuration permits the app to reach its backup storage through that network.
corrections.reason: Current App Service documentation distinguishes existing linked-database custom backups, which continue until 31 March 2028, from new configurations whose linked-database selections were already removed in November 2025 and April 2026.
